families.name: Enterprise IP
families.description: Cisco IOS routers and switches in nine size buckets, from access switches to stress-test cores.

families.name: Optical transport (TL1)
families.description: TL1 network elements over SSH: Ciena 6500, Infinera DTN-X and Cisco ONS 15454, with gateway and remote nodes.

models.description: Access switch: 24 to 48 interfaces, basic VLANs, SNMP, no routing.
Aggregation or small router: 48 interfaces, OSPF, small ACLs, logging.
Core router: multi-area OSPF, BGP (10 neighbours), large ACLs, QoS, crypto maps.
DC core or firewall: massive ACLs, VRFs, extensive BGP, prefix-lists, route-maps.
Stress, hyperscale edge: 256 interfaces, 100 ACLs, 6K static routes, 30 BGP, 50 VRFs.
Stress, regional spine: 384 interfaces, 160 ACLs, 12K static routes, 40 BGP, 70 VRFs.
Stress, SP core: 512 interfaces, 240 ACLs, 24K static routes, 60 BGP, 100 VRFs.
Stress, pathological: 768 interfaces, 380 ACLs, 48K static routes, 100 BGP, 150 VRFs.
Stress, max: 1024 interfaces, 600 ACLs, 96K static routes, 160 BGP, 220 VRFs.
Ciena 6500 node: ACT-USER login, then RTRV-EQPT shelf inventory (7-slot 6500). No remote NEs.
Ciena 6500 gateway NE fronting 2 to 5 remote NEs, addressed by TID; RTRV-NE-LIST lists them.

options.name: rne_dual_home_pct
options.help: Percent of each gateway's remote NEs drawn from a shared pool, so the same RNE is reachable through more than one gateway.

models.description: Infinera DTN-X node fronting 12 to 30 remote nodes; paged RTRV-TIDMAP and per-node inventories.
Cisco ONS 15454 gateway NE fronting 3 to 8 end NEs; positional RTRV-MAP-NETWORK records and per-ENE inventories.
